0022600041.text: The Kings host the Trail Blazers in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, Sacramento's 12th of the season, as they sit at 1-10 overall, 0-6 at home, and on a four-game losing streak, 8.5 games back in the Pacific and 14th in the West. Portland comes in at 7-3, third in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, 8th in the West, with a win in its last game and a 7-3 mark over its last ten. The Kings trail the season series 0-1 after a 128-120 loss in Sacramento on October 23, and they lost all four meetings in 2025-26. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) and Precious Achiuwa (lower leg bruise), while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle).
